summary: Frontend-only regression re-test of the 3 fixes on the 'Create Production Order' tab of /production-confirmation (iteration_88 follow-up). Synthetic vms_session cookie minted via tests/_setup_pc_session.py and DELETED after the run; the create-and-release POST + status polls were mocked via page.route so NO real SAP Proposal/Order was created by this test. ALL 3 FIXES VERIFIED WORKING. (1) BUG FIX 1 (swallowed first click): typed BK-0021, blurred (real read-only GET source-of-supply-options returned 2 Production Models, Site auto-filled P2, locked), picked model BK-0021_1, then clicked create-proposal-submit-button ONCE - the POST fired on the FIRST click with the correct payload (material_id BK-0021, site P2, logistic_relationship_uuid FA163ED8-D8C6-1FD0-B5B0-BE0C99908134) and the button bounding box was byte-identical before/after the click (x=33,y=551.5) i.e. no layout jump. The blur no longer re-fires the SAP lookup (lastCheckedId guard). (2) BUG FIX 2a: no red product-not-recognized-warning appeared at any point for the valid BK-0021 flow (count 0 before and after submit). BUG FIX 2b: with GET source-of-supply-options/{id} force-failed to HTTP 500 via page.route, the AMBER product-lookup-failed-warning renders ('Could not verify this Product ID with SAP just now (network hiccup)...'), the red warning does NOT render (count 0), the Site field stays editable, and submit is NOT blocked - the POST fired with logistic_relationship_uuid null. Retry semantics also correct: blurring again after a failure DOES re-attempt the lookup (sosCheckFailed bypasses the lastCheckedId guard) and the picker then resolved successfully. Genuine not-found is still correctly distinguished: NOTAREALPRODUCT999 shows the RED warning and submit is blocked with the toast 'Product ID not recognized in SAP - pick one from the suggestions or check the spelling' (0 POSTs fired). (3) BUG FIX 3: elapsed counter now ticks live - sampled once per second and observed 1s,2s,3s,4s,5s,6s,7s in BOTH the button label ('Starting... (1s)' -> 'Creating Proposal in SAP... (7s)') and the progress-steps 'Elapsed: Ns' line; no 4s jumps. Light regression all green: typeahead dropdown (product-suggestions-dropdown, 7 suggestions for 'BK-00'), Site lock + 'Locked - set by the chosen Production Model above' helper, UoM select with exactly 8 options and KGM selection working, 4-step progress panel with correct amber/green step highlighting, Production Confirmation tab rendered 113 open-lot rows. Zero console errors in every flow (the only console error seen was the HTTP 500 injected by my own page.route mock).

issues: 'Requested End Date' still uses the browser-native mm/dd/yyyy date input instead of the shadcn calendar component (pre-existing since iteration_87, unchanged)
The SoS lookup state is still plain text 'Checking available Production Models...' with no spinner/skeleton (cosmetic only - the min-h-[26px] reserved wrapper means the layout no longer jumps)

action_items: Optional/low: replace the native date input on 'Requested End Date' with the shadcn calendar for consistency (pre-existing design nit, not a functional defect)
Optional/low: ProductionConfirmationPage.js is ~1021 lines - still worth splitting CreateOrderTab / ConfirmDialog / HistoryDialog / ManageReasonsDialog into modules (>700-line guideline)
critical_code_review_comments: Fixes are implemented as described: checkSourceOfSupply() early-returns on `id === lastCheckedId && !sosCheckFailed`, the catch block sets sosCheckFailed instead of a silent empty-options state, the submit guard is now `sosChecked && !materialUuid && !sosCheckFailed` plus a separate sosLoading guard, and createProposal() runs a 1s setInterval ticker cleared in finally (no leak). Verified live.

Minor: after a successful create the code resets materialId/sosOptions/sosChecked but not lastCheckedId - harmless today because the input's onChange sets lastCheckedId=null, but resetting it alongside the other state would be clearer.

context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_88's 3 issues are all CLOSED. To re-test: `cd /app/backend && python tests/_setup_pc_session.py` prints a token; add it as cookie vms_session for domain sap-data-sync.preview.emergentagent.com, then delete the auth_users/auth_sessions docs (oid TEST-QA-OID) afterwards. Always mock POST '**/api/production-confirmation/create-and-release-order' -> {job_id} and '**/.../status/**' -> cycling statuses so no real SAP Order is created. GET source-of-supply-options is read-only/safe. Happy-path product: BK-0021 (2 models, site P2). Submit now works on the FIRST click. Note the create form validates in this order: actor name -> product/site/qty required -> sosLoading -> not-recognized, so to hit the not-recognized guard the Site field must be filled.
